description:
Ukraine's Unified Register of Debtors (Єдиний реєстр боржників, ЄРБ): persons
with an open, unsatisfied enforcement proceeding.

An entry is dropped at the first daily sync after its proceeding closes, so "not
listed" means nothing was open as of `as_of`, never that nothing ever was. The register publishes no dates, so rows
carry none and arrive in arbitrary order.

`ua_enforcement_proceedings` also holds closed and refused proceedings.

debtor_code.description: Exact ЄДРПОУ. ЄРБ omits РНОКПП; use q.

debtor_kind.description: фізична особа, юридична особа or невідомо.

q.description: Word search over debtor name, code and proceeding number. All words must match; each matches as a prefix. Not the office -- see `executor_department` on the explorer.
